name: JailJudge
intro: JailJudge是一个用于全面评估大型语言模型（LLM）抵御越狱攻击能力的基准。它包含了合成、对抗性、真实世界和多语言等多种风险场景，并配备了高质量的人工标注数据集。该基准还引入了一个多智能体框架，以提供可解释的细粒度评分，并推出了一个端到端的评判模型JAILJUDGE Guard。
org: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST)
build_method: 人工标注, 自动生成, 混合
metric: Accuracy, Attack Success Rate (ASR), F1 Score
language: 英文, 中文, 多语言
intro_en: JailJudge is a benchmark for comprehensively evaluating large language models' (LLM) resistance to jailbreak attacks. It includes various risk scenarios such as synthetic, adversarial, real-world, and multilingual, accompanied by a high-quality human-annotated dataset. The benchmark also introduces a multi-agent framework for interpretable fine-grained scoring and launches an end-to-end evaluation model, JAILJUDGE Guard.
metric_en: Accuracy, Attack Success Rate (ASR), F1 Score

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.12855. JailJudge builds a jailbreak-judge benchmark covering broad-risk, adversarial, in-the-wild, deceptive, and multilingual scenarios. JAILJUDGETRAIN contains 35k+ instruction-tuning prompt-response pairs from six prompt sources and diverse responses from closed-source, open-source, and defense-enhanced LLMs. JAILJUDGETEST includes a 4.5k+ human-labeled ID set and a 6k+ multilingual OOD set across ten languages. Human annotation uses trained annotators, manual labeling, GPT-4 labeling, cross-comparison, and multi-person voting. JailJudge MultiAgent uses judging agents, voting agents, and an inference agent to provide reasoning explanations plus 1-10 jailbreak scores; threshold alpha maps scores to jailbroken labels. MultiAgent outputs construct training ground truth, then JAILJUDGE Guard is instruction-tuned for API-free explainable fine-grained judging and evaluated against judge baselines.
